name: Sentinel Tower
summary: Defenders watch Westfall from Sentinel Tower atop Sentinel Hill. Gryan Stoutmantle and the People's Militia organize resistance against bandits, gnolls, and the Defias Brotherhood.

sections.title: Watch over the Wild West
sections.body: Sentinel Tower rises above the unsettled plains of Westfall. With Stormwind's official army largely absent and aid withheld, local volunteers and veterans joined together around this central stronghold. From its stone heights, lookouts can see across the dusty plains, from abandoned pumpkin patches to the misty shores. They watch for highwaymen and gnoll raiding parties moving through the region.

sections.title: Headquarters of the Militia
sections.body: Gryan Stoutmantle and the local leadership direct the militia from Sentinel Tower. Makeshift defenses surround the stronghold, where wounded refugees and weary soldiers gather, and homesteaders driven from their lands find emergency shelter. Militia members piece together reports about the Defias Brotherhood and organize volunteers into strikes against the syndicate that has brought Westfall to ruin.

faq.q: Who is in charge at Sentinel Tower?
faq.answer: Gryan Stoutmantle directs operations from Sentinel Tower. As head of the People's Militia, he coordinates Westfall's displaced farmers in their defense and recruits willing adventurers.

faq.q: Why is the tower so important to Westfall?
faq.answer: Sentinel Tower is the only fortified garrison and lookout post left in the central plains. With Stormwind leaving Westfall largely undefended, it is the last organized bastion of order and safety for refugees in the region.

faq.q: Who stays in and around the tower?
faq.answer: Militia officers, sentinels on watch, quartermasters, and farmsteader families stay in and around Sentinel Tower. The families have left their ruined lands to seek shelter near its stone walls.

faq.q: What threats are watched from the tower?
aliases: what does the tower guard against
faq.answer: Sentinels watch for Riverpaw gnolls, murlocs moving inland from the coast, and roaming highwaymen and brigands of the Defias Brotherhood.

angles.text: Sentinel Tower speaks to the grit of ordinary Alliance subjects fighting for their homeland while Stormwind's high lords turn a blind eye.
As a human of the kingdom, you see how Stormwind's agrarian breadbasket is barely holding together against rebellion from within.
